title: The remote_query function will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
In November 2026, the `remote_query` table-valued function will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Use `remote_query` to run queries on external databases in their native SQL syntax, with credentials from a Unity Catalog connection.

See [Query external databases using the `remote_query` function](/aws/en/query-federation/remote-queries).

ref_links.text: Query external databases using the remote_query function
